question: Use oc auth can-i to check whether my current delegated identity can get pods, list deployments and patch deployments in podpilot-test, and list nodes cluster-wide. Present the permission results. These are permission checks only; do not perform any write.

result.answer:
## Permission results

| Check | Scope | Allowed |
|---|---|---:|
| Get pods | `podpilot-test` | **Yes** |
| List deployments | `podpilot-test` | **Yes** |
| Patch deployments | `podpilot-test` | **Yes** |
| List nodes | Cluster-wide | **Yes** |

These were `oc auth can-i` authorization checks only. No write was performed.

evidence_ledger.command:
set -u
[REDACTED] 'get pods in podpilot-test: '; oc auth can-i get pods -n podpilot-test
printf 'list deployments in podpilot-test: '; oc auth can-i list deployments.apps -n podpilot-test
printf 'patch deployments in podpilot-test: '; oc auth can-i patch deployments.apps -n podpilot-test
printf 'list nodes cluster-wide: '; oc auth can-i list nodes
evidence_ledger.stderr_excerpt: Warning: resource 'nodes' is not namespace scoped
evidence_ledger.stdout_excerpt:
get pods in podpilot-test: yes
list deployments in podpilot-test: yes
patch deployments in podpilot-test: yes
list nodes cluster-wide: yes
